description.en: Native KittenTTS Mini 0.8 English text-to-speech with eight built-in voices and shared eSpeak-ng phonemization.
description.zh: 原生 KittenTTS Mini 0.8 英语文本转语音，含八个内置音色与共享的 eSpeak-ng 音素化。

speed.en: Speech speed multiplier; larger values produce faster speech. Must be finite and positive.
speed.zh: 语速倍增器；值越大，语音速度越快。必须是有限且正的。

seed.en: Decoder noise seed for the current request; omitted requests choose a fresh random seed.
seed.zh: 当前请求的解码器噪声种子；省略的请求选择一个新鲜的随机种子。

voice_id.en: Built-in voice ID or package alias; structured voice input (CLI --voice-id) takes precedence.
voice_id.zh: 内置音色 ID 或包别名；结构化 voice 输入（CLI --voice-id）优先。

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum Unicode codepoints per long-form chunk.
text_chunk_size.zh: 每个长文本分块的最大 Unicode 码点数。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)
